title: Tonelli lower bound for the annular conical integral with one fixed cutoff
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (w : Amb n ℓ → ℝ) (y : Amb n ℓ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (R ε s r : ℝ), 0 < ε → μ (closedBall y R) < ⊤ → AEStronglyMeasurable w (μ.restrict (ball y R)) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ ball y R → 0 ≤ w x ∧ w x ≤ 1) → ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → Antitone φ → (∀ u : ℝ, u ≤ 1 → φ u = 1) → (∀ u : ℝ, 1 + ε ≤ u → φ u = 0) → 0 < s → s ≤ r → (1 + ε) * r < R → ∫⁻ x in closedBall y r \ ball y ((1 + ε) * s), ENNReal.ofReal (w x / ‖x - y‖ ^ n) ∂μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (∫ t in s..r, -(∫ x, ‖x - y‖ / t * deriv φ (‖x - y‖ / t) * w x ∂μ) / t / t ^ n)
